global_reuse_rules: Repository license, model-weight license and dataset license are separate checks.
A paper reporting a trained model does not prove that downloadable weights are available.
Never use participant-level PPMI data outside the PPMI Data Use Agreement and approved environment.
Never combine visits from one participant across train, validation and test partitions.
Do not compare metrics across studies unless modality, cohort definition, split unit, preprocessing and evaluation protocol match.
Treat synthetic demonstrations and author-reported results as distinct from independently reproduced PANPM results.
